rules.question: Is this squeeze already done with no frontend timing?
must_match: const std::string when = sq.is_free() ? "no more than " + edge + " early"
rules.note: The old name came back. The word "Free" on screen belongs to BackendSqueeze::summarystr and means a different thing, so the squeeze's own test is named for what it asks. Decided by: D114, concept audit finding M41

rules.question: Where does this activation's Star Power end (its deactivation tick)?
rules.note: A second reader of the last SP-end step. Call Activation::deact_tick. Tests are out of scope because a few of them move the last step's end on purpose to make a different path. Decided by: D114, concept audit finding M44

rules.question: What does squeezing out this row cost?
must_match: const int lost = row.points - core::backend_row_value(off, row.points, row.sqout_points,
return points - backend_row_value(offset_ms, points, sqout_points, SqOutPosition::Exact,
must_not_match: const int lost = core::sqout_cost(off, row.points, row.sqout_points, leeway_ms);
rules.note: A squeeze-out's cost worked out again from the row's value. Call core::sqout_cost. Decided by: D114, concept audit finding M45
